name: Goodricke Group Limited
about: Goodricke Group Limited cultivates, manufactures, and sells tea in India and internationally. The company offers bulk teas, including black, green, CTC, and blended teas; and instant teas, such as black, Darjeeling, green, and oolong teas that are in hot and cold water soluble forms. It also owns and operates tea gardens, instant tea plant, tea lounges, and tea blending units. In addition, the company offers alternate crops comprising ginger, garlic, and turmeric, as well as dairy farming and related products which include milk and ghee under A2 Ghee brand name. The company was incorporated in 1977 and is headquartered in Kolkata, India.
